parameters.content:
## ① INPUT
Manual Trigger + Project Configuration. Edit the five
paths here to point at your mounted project folder,
optional manifest, and output directory.

## ② DISCOVERY, METADATA, HASHING,
## DUPLICATES & DETERMINISTIC VALIDATION
One Python call (Execute Command) does discovery, metadata
extraction, SHA-256 + perceptual hashing, exact/near-duplicate
detection, filename-based version clustering, and technical +
manifest validation. Delegated to Python because it needs
Pillow / imagehash / ffprobe -- see docs/architecture-decision.md §3.
One bad file never aborts the run (caught inside Python).

## ③ IDENTIFY AMBIGUOUS CLUSTERS
Version-family clusters that reduce to a single unique file
hash are resolved deterministically (no AI call). Everything
else becomes one item per cluster for the AI step.

## ④ AI ANALYSIS
One HTTP call (via the sub-workflow) per ambiguous version
cluster -- not per file. Plain HTTP Request + hand-rolled JSON
Schema validation + one retry, not the LangChain Agent node --
see docs/architecture-decision.md §4. Trivial duplicate-only
clusters skip AI entirely -- see docs/deterministic-vs-ai.md.

## ⑤ CLASSIFICATION (DETERMINISTIC SCORING)
Weighted scoring engine ported from python/src/classification.py.
AI confidence is ONE input among several -- never the decision
by itself. Every asset gets a status + numeric score + reasons.

## ⑥ REVIEW SPLIT
Confident assets skip straight to auto-resolution.
Anything with requires_review=true (near a threshold, an
unresolved duplicate/version cluster, or a failed AI call)
goes to the Human Review form instead.

## ⑦ HUMAN REVIEW
n8n's native Wait node (Resume: On Form Submitted) pauses this
execution and renders the review queue as a form. No custom
server needed. See docs/human-review.md.

## ⑧ DELIVERY BUILDER
Confident + reviewed assets recombine, get written back to disk,
then Python copies approved files into delivery/<category>/.
Copy-only -- source files are never deleted or moved.

## ⑨ MANIFEST + REPORT
Two final Python calls generate delivery_manifest.json/html and
processing_report.html from the same asset ledger, so they can
always be cross-checked against each other.

## ⚠ ERROR HANDLING PATTERN
Every Execute Command node uses Continue On Fail. The guarded
check-then-log pattern shown here on the Discovery step (IF →
Build Aborted Run Notice) applies uniformly to the later Python
calls too -- omitted there for canvas readability. Per-file
failures never reach this level; Python already isolates those
(see docs/architecture-decision.md §9).
